# Configuration

Settings stay outside the snippet database, normally ~/.config/typerelay/settings.yml:

    trigger_prefix: ","
    sync_url: ""

XDG_CONFIG_HOME is respected. Prefix changes affect this machine without rewriting synchronized snippets.
Connect through browser approval with typerelay connect; changing a URL alone never redirects existing credentials.

## Libraries and YAML

All libraries, including local-only libraries, are SQLite records in the configured directory.
The engine reads SQLite, not YAML files.

    # Generated by TypeRelay.
    # Edit snippets through the TypeRelay TUI or web app.
    # Changes made in a text editor are not synchronized.
    matches:
      - trigger: naf
        replace: |-
          Sincerely,
          Nitai
          CEO & Founder

Import using the web app or typerelay import FILE --name NAME.
Export with typerelay export NAME DESTINATION; existing destinations are not overwritten.
Abbreviations stay bare. Formatting/comments are generated; expansion text and line breaks are preserved.
Imports validate all active abbreviations and limits atomically.

Older prefixed YAML can still use the legacy typerelay migrate command before database import.
See [migration](web/development.md).
